name: Michigan
modelName: Michigan Child Support Formula: general care equation on family net income bands (base amount + marginal percentage)
incomeLabel: Net income: after income taxes and mandatory deductions, as the state defines it.

extra.equation: { A + [ B x ( C - D ) ] } x E = G, using the band with the highest incomeAmount not exceeding C (2025 MCSF 3.02(B)(2))
extra.belowFirstBand: The supplement lists no band below the first incomeAmount; base support for a family income below it is not stated in the tables (see uncertain).
extra.columns: bands per number of children (1..5, 5 = five or more): incomeAmount D, basePercentage, baseSupport A, marginalPercentage B

statute.name: MCL 552.605; Michigan Child Support Formula Manual 2025 and 2025 MCSF Supplement (SCAO Friend of the Court Bureau)

incomeDefinition: 'Net income' means all income minus the deductions and adjustments permitted by the manual (2025 MCSF 2.01(A)); income includes wages, overtime, commissions, bonuses (Medicare wages box of the W-2), business, self-employment and rental earnings and other listed items (2.01(C)). Deductions include actual federal, state and local income taxes, FICA/Medicare, alimony paid to a third person, and an adjustment multiplier (83%/75%/68%/64%/60%) for additional children from other relationships (2.07, 2.08).
modelText: Base support (2025 MCSF 3.02): family net income C = sum of the parents' monthly net incomes, counting a parent only if above the Low Income Threshold. General Care Equation: G = {A + [B x (C - D)]} x E, where D = highest Income Amount in the General Care Support Table (by number of children) not exceeding C, A = Base Support for that row, B = marginal percentage, E = parent's percentage share of family income (rounded to the nearest hundredth percent); round G to the nearest dollar. Low Income Equation (parent at or below the threshold H): L = 10% x parent's net income. Low Income Transition Equation (parent above H): T = (H x 10%) + [(I - H) x P], P = 50%/55%/60%/65%/70% for 1/2/3/4/5+ children; the parent's base support is the lower of G and T. Parental Time Offset (3.03): [Ao^2.5 x Bs - Bo^2.5 x As] / [Ao^2.5 + Bo^2.5], Ao/Bo = annual overnights with parent A/B, As/Bs = base support of A/B; negative result = A pays, positive = B pays.
sharedText: The parental time offset applies to every determination where the approximate annual overnights with each parent can be determined (no threshold): [Ao^2.5 x Bs - Bo^2.5 x As] / [Ao^2.5 + Bo^2.5]. It does not apply when a nonparent has custody; a change of at least 21 overnights (or one exceeding the modification threshold) allows a motion to modify (2025 MCSF 3.03).
addOnsText: actual net child-care costs (after subsidies and credits) allocated by each parent's percentage share of family income; payer's share ordered as a monthly child care obligation (2025 MCSF 3.06) premiums for the children allocated between parents by income share; ordinary medical expense amount ($200 per child per year) apportioned by income share (2025 MCSF 3.04-3.05; 2025 MCSF-S 2.02) A support obligation = base support adjusted by the parental time offset + medical support (ordinary and additional medical expenses, health-care coverage premiums) + child care (2025 MCSF 3.01(A)).
lowIncomeText: The Low Income Threshold is $1,255.00 (2024 HHS poverty guideline) (2025 MCSF-S 2.01(A)). A parent at or below it pays 10% of net income and that income is excluded from family income for the other parent's calculation; a parent above it pays the lower of the General Care Equation and the Low Income Transition Equation (2025 MCSF 2.09, 3.02(C)-(D)).

emancipation.text: Support may continue after 18 while the child regularly attends high school full time with a reasonable expectation of graduating and lives full time with the recipient (or at an institution), but never after the child reaches 19 years and 6 months (MCL 552.605b(2)).

facts.text: Michigan's guideline is the Michigan Child Support Formula manual plus its most current supplement, published by the SCAO Friend of the Court Bureau; the 2025 edition took effect January 1, 2025 (2025 MCSF 1.01).
The parenting time offset raises each parent's annual overnights to the power 2.5, so support falls gradually as overnights rise rather than at a threshold (2025 MCSF 3.03).
A friend of the court office must petition to modify when the recommended amount differs from the current order by more than 10% or $50 a month, whichever is greater (2025 MCSF 4.05).
Weekly amounts are converted to monthly by multiplying by 4.35 and biweekly by 2.175 (2025 MCSF 4.06(A)).
The 2025 supplement adjusts the General Care Support Table income levels using the February 2024 CPI-U Detroit from an April 2023 base (2025 MCSF-S 2.03(A)).

sources.name: Michigan: MCL 552.605; Michigan Child Support Formula Manual 2025 and 2025 MCSF Supplement (SCAO Friend of the Court Bureau)
